controls.requirement: The authoritative state boundary, client prediction, reconciliation, validation, and anti-cheat rules are explicit.
Join, leave, disconnect, reconnect, resume, timeout, duplicate, ordering, and late-event behavior preserve consistency.
Matchmaking queue time, fairness, cancellation, party integrity, region selection, abuse controls, and fallbacks meet targets.
Concurrent players, matches, connections, fan-out, queue depth, latency, backpressure, and cost are load-tested.
State snapshots, event ordering, conflict rules, save compatibility, replay, corruption recovery, and auditability are verified.
Partial-region, dependency, realtime transport, and matchmaking failures degrade safely and have rollback and communication paths.
